style.name: Pearl & Noir Paris
style.definition: Pearl linen, black accents and graphic art give a Parisian room a crisp contemporary edge.
style.materials: pearl linen; blackened oak; pale marble; nickel; charcoal wool
style.living: pearl rounded 205cm sofa; charcoal wool swivel chair; oval pale-marble table with black legs; blackened-oak media cabinet; 105cm blackened-oak round table and four pearl chairs; nickel opal globe pendant
style.bed: pearl upholstered queen with black piping; black oak nightstands; opal nickel lamps; charcoal throw
style.solarium: black aluminum outdoor frames with pearl cushions; round black outdoor dining set
style.implement: Add a slender antique-silver mirror and two bold monochrome works; use warm light to soften the graphic contrast.
style.avoid: Avoid glossy black walls or oversized mirrors.
